vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-96760
vulnerability.description: authlib: signature verification bypass via deserialize_json

statements.justification: The pinned gpt-researcher 0.16.0 dependency chain ships authlib 1.7.2. The owner decided on 2026-10-28 to keep the current versions in this remediation round; the upgrade path (authlib >= 1.9.1) is tracked as an open item before publication. The server does not expose Authlib's OAuth/OIDC server surface, but that is a deployment property, not a fixed code path.
